reviews_captured_by_me.text: Roman installed this backslash in my in-laws house in Everett Wa. The layout was perfectly centered on the window, and the corner was flawlessly book-matched. This work was done about 6 years ago and still looks brand new!

This is the second time we have used Model Tile. The first time was for installation of new tile in a remodeled family room. which was fantastic. This time we needed their help repairing and improving a tile job we inherited with our home. I not only have a much more attractive and functional shower, I learned a good deal about what to look for when assessing the quality of tile work where water is involved. Will definitely use them again should the need arise.
Roman was professional and easy to work with. His pricing was reasonable, and he completed the work promptly. I'd gradly recommend him to others.
